voiceSummary: B.A.G. Films and Media Limited submitted newspaper publications for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 5, 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 79.64 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 55.67 lakh rupees in the previous year. Consolidated net profit after tax was 4,018.81 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Foseco India Limited also reported un-audited consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 6, 2026. Consolidated net profit after tax was 4,018.81 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company acquired shares in Foseco Crucible India Limited and sold them, recording a net loss of 349.27 lakh rupees.
